selection_rule: Reject any candidate with an unsafe or incomplete training episode; among remaining candidates rank by useful_pass_count, then safe_contact_count, then lower mean minimum foot-ball distance, then lower candidate_index. This is development selection only; validation scenes are also already consumed by v25-v27.
interpretation: Bounded physical parameter search for interception navigation in the frozen 3v3 world. This is training on failed scenes, not fresh promotion or a neural actor-critic.
